prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on what you need (branding vs performance vs PR), your industry, budget, scope, and whether you want a large full‑service shop or a small specialist.

Two well‑known Kansas City agencies worth considering (depending on your needs):
- Barkley — large, award‑winning creative and brand agency; good for big campaigns and brand work.
- VMLY&R (originally VML) — global network with strong capabilities across strategy, creative and digital.

How I can help you choose
Tell me:
- What type of marketing do you need? (branding, digital/paid media, SEO/content, social, PR, B2B lead gen, etc.)
- Your industry (B2B, B2C, nonprofit, healthcare, retail…)
- Rough budget and timeline
- Do you prefer local, boutique, or large national agencies?

What I’ll do once you tell me
- Provide a tailored shortlist (3–5 Kansas City agencies) matched to your goals
- Include key strengths, relevant case examples, ballpark pricing/engagement model, and contact info
- Suggest questions to ask them and how to evaluate proposals

If you want a quick, general recommendation now:
- Big creative/branding: Barkley or VMLY&R
- For a tailored shortlist, tell me the details above and I’ll compile one.
